title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta2

## Canonical shadow hardening beta

This beta keeps Canonical Mower State in **shadow** mode. Field diagnostics from
X390, H215, H1500 and i108 were used to harden the two parity cases found in
0.5.0-beta1. The matching frontend prerelease is **Navimower Map Card
0.4.0-beta2**.

## CycleEngine / ZoneLedger

- A hard vendor coverage drop is no longer accepted as a new cycle when the
  vendor reports the **same vendor start** timestamp. The retained monotonic
  peak stays authoritative until a stronger boundary appears: a newer vendor
  start, explicit reset or zone-geometry change.
- Beta1 ledgers that were first created after a vendor regression can repair
  their peak from the persisted History cycle state, but only when that History
  peak carries the exact same vendor start timestamp. This is a migration seed,
  not a permanent legacy publication dependency.
- Verified 100% holds are now represented in the ledger diagnostics as
  completion holds while the raw vendor percentage remains visible.
- New regression coverage reproduces the X390 100/69 -> 0 same-cycle case and
  verifies that a genuinely newer vendor start still resets immediately.

## Parity diagnostics

- A value that is missing in the legacy model but known in Canonical v2 is now
  classified as a **canonical enrichment**, not an incompatibility. This covers
  the H215 task-area case found in beta1.
- Diagnostics expose both compatibility match and strict match, plus the
  enrichment fields.

## Position diagnostics

- Adds explicit MQTT pose visibility/freshness diagnostics.
- Private-cloud fallback now reports mqtt_pose_missing, mqtt_pose_stale or
  mqtt_pose_unavailable as the reason when applicable.
- This makes sparse/no-pose H1 behavior distinguishable from a stale pose
  without changing mower control or public position entities.

## Safety

Public entities, services, Schedule, Gate, History and Map API remain on the
existing runtime in beta2. Canonical v2 is still diagnostic-only; authority
cutover is deferred until the new field diagnostics are clean.

Test this as the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta2
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta2
